summary:
Artemis Base

Players take control of a lunar base, managing its resources, finances, and operations while making strategic decisions and investing in facilities and equipment to improve their settlement.

The game addresses the challenge by giving young people an interactive opportunity to experience the complexities of space mission management. It makes space exploration more accessible while helping players develop problem-solving, resource management, and decision-making skills.

The ultimate goal is to build and maintain a sustainable lunar base through effective planning and strategic decisions.
